items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Mike Bayer was in the sextet with Benny.

ctx.x: Sid Weiss. Oh, yes, I played with Sid Weiss, much later, after I rejoined Benny for the "Seven Lively Arts Show" and then after that did some dates on the road. And Sid Weiss was on bass with Red Norvo and Slam Stewart. Mike Bayer was in the sextet with Benny.

Well, when you and I just started getting into New York in the '30s, let's see, who were some of the great drummers? I think George Wettling was around and there was -- who was -- Kaiser Marshall (PHONETIC), did you --
